item.title: Aviation Week & Space Technology
item.description: Aviation Week & Space Technology, often abbreviated Aviation Week or AW&ST, is the flagship magazine of the Aviation Week Network, a division of Informa. The bi-weekly magazine is available in print and online, reporting on the aerospace, defense and aviation industries, with a core focus on aerospace technology. The use of press releases to update the public led to the magazine being informally called "Aviation Leak and Space Mythology".
